name: Visible Faces Driven Ray Casting
definition: A memory-efficient ray casting algorithm for unstructured grids (tetrahedral/hexahedral) that reduces memory footprint by storing only the face data of the most recent traversals, exploiting ray coherence among neighboring pixels.
summary: Visible Faces Driven Ray Casting is a memory-efficient algorithm for unstructured grids that minimizes storage by processing pixels in groups defined by visible exterior faces and caching only current face data.
